subject: Candidate Tom Avery - same-day reschedule request / coverage options
messages:
From: Tom Avery <tom.avery@example.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Hannah Lee <hannah@talentbridge.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Jul 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Request: shift today's interview slot

Hi Ben / Hannah,

I'm really sorry to send this last-minute, but I woke up with a 102F fever and I'm not in great shape to do the live panel today at 4:00pm PST. I can either reschedule to tomorrow (any time after 2pm PST) or switch to a take-home coding exercise + 30-min sync when I'm recovered.

I know this was booked tightly — happy to be flexible on timing. Apologies again.

Best,
Tom
Tom Avery
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Tom Avery <tom.avery@example.com>, Hannah Lee <hannah@talentbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Jul 2028 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: shift today's interview slot

Thanks for the heads up, Tom — sorry to hear you're under the weather. No problem at all. Two quick options from our side:

- Option A: Reschedule the panel to tomorrow (Fri 7/28) between 3:00–5:00pm PST. We can confirm a 3:15pm slot if that works.
- Option B: Convert today to a take-home coding challenge (we'll send the prompt) and then do a 30-minute follow-up call when you're feeling better.

If you prefer Option A, tell us your earliest availability tomorrow and we'll lock it. If Option B, we'll send the exercise and an invite for a short sync later next week.

I'm attaching the role JD and the interview rubric so you have context for either flow. I can also update the Greenhouse record and send a new calendar invite once you confirm.

Attachments: senior_backend_jd.pdf, eval_rubric.xlsx

Ben Carter
Recruiting Partner — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | (650) 555-0123

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Jul 2028 09:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: shift today's interview slot

Ben — quick heads up: I'm the primary on-call for platform incidents today from 3–6pm and may get paged. If Tom wants to keep any part of the loop today, I can't guarantee I'll be uninterrupted.

I'm happy to take a rescheduled slot tomorrow at 3pm if that helps, and Marissa can cover my part of the panel today if the candidate prefers to proceed.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Tom Avery <tom.avery@example.com>, Hannah Lee <hannah@talentbridge.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Jul 2028 09:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: shift today's interview slot

I can cover Laura's segment today at 4pm if Tom would prefer to keep the original time and do a shortened panel. My availability is open from 3:30–5:00pm. If the candidate is not up for it, I'm also flexible for tomorrow at 3pm.

If we proceed today, proposal: 3x15min focused interviews instead of the usual 4x30 — quick system design, code review, and a behavioral chat. I'll take the system design slot. Ben, I can accept a calendar update — please include the adjusted timings and the evaluation rubric in the invite so I can prep quickly.

Marissa
Senior Engineer — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Tom Avery <tom.avery@example.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Lee <hannah@talentbridge.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Jul 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: shift today's interview slot

Thanks everyone — I really appreciate the flexibility. I'm still running a fever and don't want to risk a poor performance for the panel or pass anything on to you. I'll take Option A and reschedule to tomorrow. My preferred window is 3:00–4:30pm PST tomorrow (7/28). 3:15pm would be perfect.

Please send the updated calendar invite and any prep notes; I'll confirm as soon as I see it. Sorry again for the disruption.

—Tom

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
